Team —

Thanks for the prep yesterday. Attached is Q2 slate v3 with the owner assignments and the measurement rubrics populated (Q2_2027_OKR_slate_v3.pdf). This is the command-center view we’ll present in the QBR; before we lock it I need a quick owners' affirmation and any redlines by EOD today.

Top asks:
- Owners: please confirm you can commit to the measurement bar and the primary milestone dates. If not, flag which line item (sheet + row) and propose an alternate.
- Kimberly: we need an adjusted risk mitigation note on the Dedicated capacity cadence—one short paragraph.
- Marissa: call out any dependencies on Sales Ops for enablement assets; if you need procurement support, say so.
- Sean/Irene: two bullets on "fallback/resilience" strategy for model routing (we’ll include in the QBR slide).

I’ve put a 30m owners rollcall in your calendars (owners_rollcall.ics) for 4/15 10:00 PDT to confirm final sign-off. If anyone cannot make it, reply here with a time slot or sign-off in-line.

Link to working folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ2_OKR_Slates
HubSpot note: HUBSPOT-REC-98341

Thanks —
Hannah

Hannah —

Thanks, saw the slate. Quick notes:
- I can own the Dedicated cadence risk paragraph; draft below (feel free to paste into the doc):
  "Dedicated capacity cadence: commit to T-7 day spike window for seasonal load. If we anticipate sustained >60% peak utilization, trigger procurement fast-path; fallback to quantized model variant for best-effort SLA. Owning: Infra PM."
- Measurement bars look good overall; I flagged two rows where we should change success criteria from "50% latency improvement" to "median latency < 120ms" (I left comments in the PDF).

I can make the owners rollcall on 4/15.

—Kimberly

Hannah / Kim —

Thanks for the clear asks. Two items from my side:
1) Sales Ops dependency — the "use-case enablement pack" is required for the ARR motion; Sales Ops needs 3 weeks to produce the asset once we finalize the scope. If we want the asset for Q2 launch, we should lock the scope by 4/20.
2) Procurement — the enterprise discount cadence for Dedicated pulls from Legal (contract addendum). I’ve added a TODO in the drive and opened a Confluence stub with procurement steps: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PROC/Q2+Dedicated+Addendum

Also, small redline on objective 2.3: recommend we narrow the target audience from "mid-market" to "mid-market + scale-startups" — that changes measurement denominator slightly. Commented in the PDF.

I can confirm owners rollcall, but if we need final signatures before then, I can provide explicit sign-off in-line: I approve measurement bars and milestone dates for items assigned to me, contingent on Sales Ops locking scope by 4/20.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
GM, Customer Growth
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the speed — clear alignment. Summary and next steps (please reply with a single-line ack to make the record explicit):
- Kim: paragraph accepted; injecting into the risk notes now.
- Marissa: noted dependency and conditional approval (Sales Ops scope lock by 4/20).
- Sean/Irene: please drop two bullets into the shared doc by 5pm PDT so I can include them on the QBR slide (fallback/resilience).
- Final doc: I will push v3 -> v4 with these edits by EOD and circulate the final signature-ready PDF. If no objections by 11:59pm PDT, the slate is considered endorsed and I’ll mark as "owner-signed".

QBR dry-run: schedule suggestion 4/21 09:30-10:30 PDT. If that works, I’ll invite exec reviewers (CTO, Head of Sales) and Emily/Rajesh as external stakeholders for the partner section.

One-line ack here is fine if you can’t make the call. Thanks all —
Hannah
